summary: evidence-gc keeps the per-crate rust-tests keys of every live tree (open pull requests, branch tips, recent main), keyed by main's scripts/rust-test-keys; a live tree whose crates cannot be keyed keeps every rust-tests key; in a partial clone the manifests are fetched in batches before keying

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The GC summary gains crate_keys.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. GC deletes strictly less: only rust-tests keys that no live tree projects to.

compatibility.detail: The GC timer runs main's evidence-gc, so this applies at the next run once on main. A main without scripts/rust-test-keys keys nothing this way, as before.

manual.detail: The evidence-gc timer on the build host that runs it was disabled on 2026-10-28 until this lands: re-enable it (systemctl --user enable --now evidence-gc.timer) after merge, and remove ~/.local/state/evidence-gc/PAUSED.
